summary: Wii-specific game entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Wii Play
entries.definitive_edition: Original Wii release on hardware with real Wii Remote

emulation.emulator: Dolphin only with real Wii Remote/sensor setup
emulation.notes: Original Wii hardware is preferred because pointer/motion input is central.

primary.version: Original Wii release with Wii Remote
primary.why: Wii Play is built around Wii Remote pointer and motion demonstrations, so original Wii hardware with real Wii Remotes is the fidelity route. It should not be merged with Wii Play: Motion, which is a separate MotionPlus sequel.
primary.how_to_play: Use Wii hardware or Wii U backward compatibility with real Wii Remotes and sensor bar. Record region, controller condition, Mii state, player count, medal/progression state, and whether Wii Play: Motion was compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if real Wii Remote behavior and pointer calibration are verified.
secondary.why: The controls are the point; emulation without correct input is not a faithful route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record controller/Mii/player-count state and keep Wii Play: Motion separate.
